name: github-agent-events
description: Poll GitHub repository events and turn new issues, pull requests, and pushes into local agent tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Turn GitHub events into local agent reminders.
interface.longDescription: Polls the GitHub Events API with an existing GitHub App token, deduplicates deliveries locally, and writes safe task prompts for configured agents.
defaultPrompt: Watch my GitHub repository for new agent work.
Show me the latest GitHub events for my agents.
